reuse.why: It changes the existing shared range helper and makes the budget schedule template call getScheduledAmount, the same helper every other server and client consumer already uses.

duplication.why: No new logic is duplicated; the template's own isbetween dispatch is removed in favour of the shared helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getScheduledAmount, with its tests next to it.

scope.why: Only the range helper, its one divergent consumer, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: A renamed, single-purpose helper behind one entry point that all paths use makes future rule changes a one-place edit.

one_place.where: getRangedAmountWorstCase in shared/schedules.ts, reached through getScheduledAmount by forecast, schedules app (actions, posting), preview, budget schedule template and the client views
